fusions.name: Skipping Stones
fusions.desc: Skips a flat stone across the ground that deals 4 damage and leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Dust-Kick Flurry
fusions.desc: Kicks a cone of grit ahead of you, dealing 7 damage to everything caught in it. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Scree Sprint
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% and your dodge chance by 10% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hard Ground Pace
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover restores 6 stamina. Once every 5 seconds. Your armour also rises by 5%.
